items.detail: Projected starting SG with RJ Barrett (hamstring) and Kawhi Leonard (left knee) both out for Toronto; bigger scoring role likely.
Projected starting SF with Kawhi Leonard and RJ Barrett both ruled out, so his minutes and usage should be up.
Left ankle soreness: he left Wednesday's win over the Clippers after 9 minutes and was held out of the second half; a real game-time call.

Memphis frontcourt is thin: Cameron Boozer and Jerami Grant are out and Zach Edey and Isaiah Stewart are questionable, which likely explains the market pricing him well above the model's 18.9-minute projection.
Left ankle sprain from Wednesday's win over OKC (stepped on Hartenstein's foot); if he sits, Bones Hyland likely starts and Ayo Dosunmu and Terrence Shannon Jr. get more usage.
Left heel bone bruise; returned to full practice this week after missing five games, but expected to come off the bench if he plays.
Officially questionable (left hip external rotator strain), but Statz reports an expected return around Dec 13 and says he is not expected to play Friday.
Right shin contusion; has missed consecutive games for the first time this season. If he sits, Stephon Castle runs the offense.
Off the Pelicans' injury report after several weeks with jumper's knee; Dejounte Murray (ankle) is out.
Questionable with an illness on the 7:30 AM ET official report; status likely decided at warmups.
